process.title: From Design Concept to Mass Production (OEM / ODM Journey)
process.subtitle: Our structured engineering methodology guarantees zero-defect quality and cost-efficient production cycles.

steps.title: RFQ & BOM Analysis
steps.desc: Technical specification review, component sourcing feasibility, and commercial quotation within 24-48 business hours.

steps.title: DFM Engineering & Rapid Prototyping
steps.desc: Design-for-Manufacturing optimization ensuring SMT placement yields and rapid turnaround prototype builds.

steps.title: Tooling, Stencils & Pilot Run
steps.desc: Electro-polished laser stencil fabrication and controlled pilot production batches to qualify machinery tolerances.

steps.title: 100% Quality Validation (SPI, AOI, ICT, Burn-In)
steps.desc: 3D solder paste inspection, automated optical inspection, functional in-circuit testing, and dynamic thermal burn-in.

steps.title: Mass Production & FTZ Global Shipping
steps.desc: High-speed 80K CPH assembly, real-time MES serialization, and 45-minute express transit to Singapore transshipment hub.
